## Overview
Universe becomes the **package manager**, **registry**, **validator**, **installer**, and **publisher**.
This is the MVP/MVI ingestion stage.

## MVP Scope
- Load canonical schemas  
- Validate schema structure  
- Register packages  
- Install local modules  
- Publish modules to registry  

## MVI Scope
- Multi-version ingestion  
- Historical version tracking  
- Canonical diffing  
- Package lineage reconstruction  

## Example Ingestion Flow
2026-02-11 14:10:22 [universe] ingest package "schema.core"
2026-02-11 14:10:23 [universe] validate canonical fields
2026-02-11 14:10:24 [universe] register version 1.0.0


## PCMS Alignment
Universe menu integrates with:
- pcms-2026 registry menu  
- pcms-2026 validator menu  
- pcms-2026 ingestion menu  

## Versioning
Universe MVP/MVI is versioned as:
- universe-ingest-v1  
- universe-registry-v1  
- universe-validator-v1
